cases.script: name=target; declare -n r=$name; target=ok; echo $r

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref in a subshell
cases.script: t=1; declare -n r=t; ( r=2; echo $t ); echo $t

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref array keys
cases.script: declare -A m=([k]=v); declare -n r=m; echo ${!r[@]}

cases.name: gram array nameref indirect expansion of a nameref
cases.script: t=v; declare -n r=t; echo ${!r}

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref invalid target at use
cases.script: declare -n r=t; t=1; unset t; r=2; echo $t

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref to positional is refused
cases.script: declare -n r=1; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram array nameref typeset -n
cases.script: t=v; typeset -n r=t; echo $r

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref in arithmetic context
cases.script: x=3; declare -n r=x; echo $(( r * 2 )); (( r++ )); echo $x

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref to an assoc key with spaces
cases.script: declare -A m=(['a b']=v); declare -n r='m[a b]'; echo "$r"

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref declared without -n is plain
cases.script: t=v; declare r=t; echo $r

cases.name: gram array nameref nameref -p listing
cases.script: t=v; declare -n r=t; declare -p r; declare -n
